theorem m60AreaAndFilling
    (P04 : RicciFlowCurvatureTheory.{u})
    (P58 : RepairedShortLoopTrivialityTheory.{u}) :
    M60AreaTheory.{u} := by
  have core :
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (M : Type u) [TopologicalSpace M]
        [ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) M] [IsManifold (𝓡 n) ∞ M]
        (g : RiemannianMetric n M) (D : LeviCivitaData g), D.CurvatureTensorCalculus) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (M : Type u) [TopologicalSpace M]
        [ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) M] [IsManifold (𝓡 n) ∞ M]
        (J : Set ℝ) (F : RicciFlow n M J),
        ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)).prod (𝓡 n)) (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)) ∞
          (fun p : ℝ × M => (F.connection p.1).scalarCurvature p.2) (J ×ˢ Set.univ)) →
      M60AreaCore.{u} := by
    intro tensor scalar
    exact m60AreaCore_of_leastSphere tensor scalar m60LeastSphere_of_suProducers
  exact { toM60AreaCore := core P04.tensor_calculus P04.scalar_regular
          short_loop := m60ShortLoopAreaClaim_from_M58 P58 }

tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Minimal-sphere area variation] ↗ prop:rf-evolution For a fixed smooth sphere map that is branched minimal at $t_0$ in a compact three-dimensional Ricci flow, \[ \left.\frac{d}{dt}\operatorname {Area}_{g(t)}(f)\right|_{t=t_0} \leq -4\pi -\frac\rho 2\operatorname {Area}_{g(t_0)}(f) \] for every scalar lower bound $\rho $ at that time. In particular one may take the attained minimum of scalar curvature on the compact slice. At a slab endpoint the derivative is taken within the slab. Source: MT20071. Claims 18.12–18.13, pp. 426–428
